scope: Postprocessing of existing archives only; no simulator or RNG used.
spatial_sampling: 2 m native samples; 42 m bilinear samples at translated identical coordinates; no temporal interpolation.
piston: Remove the arithmetic mean of the same 2032 valid pupil samples independently at each time; retain tilt.
color_rule: One symmetric range rounded up to 100 nm covers both series and all three lag differences; no clipping.
limitations: One fixed crop and one realization for each model. Not a controlled model or aperture-only experiment.
Different layer profiles, winds, seeds and slight r0 difference remain.
Bilinear spatial interpolation mildly filters the 42 m crop; nearest-neighbor sensitivity is reported separately.
Overlapping time pairs are correlated; statistics are descriptive.
publication_note: Projection of the unchanged local analysis, omitting host paths; source hashes and all numerical results retained. Additional whole-pupil RMS ratios use the same saved scalar histories and are separate from the unchanged crop analysis.

whole_pupil_rms_changes.definition: Maximum of larger RMS / smaller RMS across every time pair at the stated lag in each complete one-second record; descriptive extrema, not typical changes.
